rule: iOS approved rules (2026-10-28/29). (1) coverage: a payment covers every expense entered before it (ts); each expense counted once; the financial date never moves an expense between stages. (2) balance: one running commission balance; due = commission of newly covered expenses + previous balance; balanceAfter = due - paid (debt carries, overpayment is credit that reduces the next commission); stored as a delta in remainingForStage so the web sum equals the balance. (3) D16 (approved 2026-10-29): editing a payment amount recomputes the balance of that payment and every later one (entry order); calculatedAmount is kept; the row text suffix is rewritten.
